law: THE HUMAN CADENCE (CR-0065, extended CR-0067): no two fleet ops share a moment. Each soldier owns personal hours across the UTC day, seeded per-day jitter, quiet hours 00:00-04:59 UTC. One publisher (human-cadence.cjs); every other social engine defers. Slots are windows, not instants - a starved runner catching up still lands inside a wide window and never inside a burst. CR-0067: the community is the home feed - soldier posts land INSIDE The Clubhouse (hive-177702 as first tag), and joining is its own staggered lane (subscribe in persona windows, budget 1 per soldier ever, max 2 per run, read-back via bridge.list_subscribers).
